Dear Tailspin Ltd,

We have processed your refund of **175 CHF (CHF-4C9H)** for the invoice currency misalignment on your account (Ticket C-8843).

**Reason:** Your original invoice was incorrectly issued in the wrong currency. This refund corrects the discrepancy as per our contract terms.

**Next Steps:** The refund should reflect in your account within 3-5 business days. If you have further questions, reply to this email or reference Ticket **C-8843**.

Regards,
IT Operations Team
